description:
Deterministic syntax-closure burn-down contract for systemverilog.ebnf (no-regression baseline). Entry rule is sv_multi_entry_root, a synthetic union of the three legitimate top-level entries (systemverilog_file, library_text, systemverilog_parseable_file) used so the gate's single-entry static analyzer can see all reach-sets at once. Long-term tooling fix: extend ast_pipeline --entry-rule to accept a list and remove sv_multi_entry_root.

v2 (2026-05-29, SV-EXH-PROOF.5.1, PGEN-SV-EXH-PROOF-0102): re-baselined max_unreachable_rules 1 to 50 and max_unreachable_branches 25 to 109 to honestly reflect the accumulated intentional-orphan surface. Each of the 50 unreachable rules is individually justified:

  - 1 known LRM mutual-recursion case: module_path_conditional_expression (documented in grammar lines 79-89; intentionally LRM-faithful; PGEN runtime RecursionGuard handles it correctly; static analyzer cannot trace mutual reference).

  - 49 LRM-decomposed number-infrastructure orphans (documented in grammar lines 416-423, PGEN-SV-EXH-PROOF-0021/.3.2 Strategy 1 precedent + RGX-0081 orphan-rule precedent). The 4 entry-point number-kind rules (binary_number, octal_number, decimal_number, hex_number) are alias passthroughs to integral_number (a clean sized/based regex) but no production references them. The remaining 45 are their decomposed helpers (binary_base/digit/value/value_tail, octal_*, hex_*, decimal_base/digit, size, exp, fixed_point_number, non_zero_decimal_digit x 2 profiles, non_zero_unsigned_number x 2, sign, x_digit, z_digit, plus 16 kw_* single-character keyword helpers like kw_A_/kw_C_/.../kw_n_3_/.../kw_o_/kw_sv_rule_).

The 109 unreachable_branches count = static sub-quantifier accounting of those same 50 unreachable rules' branches.

Drift policy: any future grammar edit that changes either ceiling MUST be leaf-owned + justified per [[feedback_grammar_edit_proof_gate_lockstep]] - re-baseline is honest closure-debt management, NOT silent masking. Adding a NEW unreachable rule requires either (a) wiring it into the reach-set, (b) deleting the orphan, or (c) opening a leaf that explains why the new orphan is intentional + bumping the ceiling.
